title: Keto Algerian Crispy Flatbread
description: A crispy flatbread infused with Algerian spices and perfect for a keto diet.
instructions: In a bowl, mix together algerian and crispy.
Cut the flatbread into bite-sized pieces.
Slice the potato into thin rounds.
In a separate bowl, mix together floral and a pinch of salt.
Brush the flatbread pieces with the floral mixture.
Arrange the flatbread on a baking sheet.
Top each piece with a potato round and a sprinkle of algerian mixture.
Bake for 15-20 minutes, or until crispy.
